name: develop
description: Plan engineering and interfaces, deliver repository changes, upgrade dependencies, review work, clean up, and improve workflows.

interface.longDescription: Ten skills for engineering/interface planning, repository changes, dependency upgrades, thread-scoped cleanup, independent review, and workflow improvement. Explicitly select Clean for thread resources, Deep Clean for a wider inventory, Upgrade for dependencies or Upgrade Codex for Codex compatibility. A native Codex context guard denies known oversized whole-file reads and offers opt-in verified result preservation; otherwise oversized results warn and pass through. No external workflow plugin required.
defaultPrompt: develop iterate: fix this repository’s failing build.
$develop:upgrade Assess and upgrade this repository’s dependencies.
develop kaizen: review these selected sessions and recommend workflow improvements.
